summary: Use KPI checks, Excel analysis, and statistical reasoning to make more defensible decisions. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Data literacy for managers helps operational leaders and analysts assess KPI evidence before acting on dashboards or reports. Participants practise defining measures, checking data quality and reconciling records in Excel, then interpreting variation and uncertainty in samples. They also set decision thresholds and document evidence-based recommendations, including when to act, investigate further, or request better data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support operational decisions using KPIs, management reports, and dashboards. It suits intermediate learners who already encounter business data in their role and need a more reliable way to question measures, assess evidence, and communicate decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience reviewing business reports, dashboards, or KPIs is expected. No coding or programming is required. Basic spreadsheet use, including sorting and formulas, will help you complete the Excel exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
